name: Kacper Lewandowski
bio:
Kacper is the rising star of Polish rallycross. Hailing from a small town known more for its potatoes than its horsepower, he's quickly become a darling of the racing world. He enjoys the spotlight that comes with his success, and his glamorous image is carefully cultivated; it's all part of the show. Despite his somewhat self-absorbed exterior, Kacper deeply values loyalty and support from those closest to him. 

While he thrives on the adrenaline of racing and the adoration of his fans, Kacper secretly yearns for someone genuine who can see past the glitz. He's not necessarily looking for marriage, but he does envision a future with a family, hoping to pass on his competitive spirit to his children. Ideally, his partner would be understanding of the demanding lifestyle that comes with being a professional athlete, while also being comfortable with the occasional extravagant splurge. He values quality time, even if his schedule is packed, and craves a partner who appreciates thoughtful gestures and shared experiences, not just lavish gifts.

physical.hairStyle: Messy, textured crop with a subtle fade on the sides
physical.description: Kacper has the lean build of a dedicated athlete, and his intense gaze hints at his competitive nature. His signature is the small, almost imperceptible scar above his left eyebrow, a souvenir from a karting accident in his youth.

meetingContext: At a post-race party hosted by a mutual sponsor following a European Rallycross Championship event.
firstImpression: He's surrounded by a small group of admirers, flashing a dazzling smile, but you immediately notice the genuine warmth in his eyes as he makes eye contact.
interests: Learning to play the electric guitar
dealBreakers: Disrespect for his family and team
Attempts to control his career or finances
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: He appreciates when someone goes out of their way to make his life easier, whether it's handling logistics, running errands, or simply ensuring he has a healthy meal.
